summary: Protocol classes defining backend obligations: two parallel hierarchies — api_builders/ (27 protocols for fluent API layer) and expression_systems/ (30 protocols for backend implementations). Substrait-aligned and Mountainash extension protocols physically separated. 57 protocol files (~7500 lines).

key_classes.name: SubstraitScalarComparisonExpressionSystemProtocol
key_classes.purpose: Protocol for comparison operations: equal, not_equal, lt, gt, coalesce, greatest, least, etc.

key_classes.name: MountainAshScalarTernaryExpressionSystemProtocol
key_classes.purpose: Protocol for ternary logic: t_eq, t_gt, t_and, t_is_true, always_true, etc.

key_classes.name: SubstraitScalarStringExpressionSystemProtocol
key_classes.purpose: Protocol for string operations: upper, lower, concat, replace, substring, etc.

extension_points: New protocol for new operation category
lifecycle_notes: Per protocol-as-contract principle: protocols are source of truth for backend obligations
Physical separation: substrait/ vs extensions_mountainash/ at both api_builders/ and expression_systems/ levels
